description_en: Binds an existing alias to a different customer master key (CMK) ID
description_zh: 更新已存在的别名所代表的主密钥（CMK）ID
name: UpdateAlias

parameters.help_en: The ID of the CMK. The ID must be globally unique
parameters.help_zh: 新的密钥ID。主密钥的全局唯一标识符。
parameters.name: key_id

parameters.help_en:
The alias that you want to bind.

The value must be 1 to 255 characters in length and must include the alias/ prefix
parameters.help_zh:
要操作的别名。  
长度为1~255个字符，必须包含前缀alias/
parameters.name: alias_name
